name: DeepSeek Search
description: Web search and page fetch via the DeepSeek Search / Fetch API (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/search), powered by DeepSeek's in-house search engine and exposed as two declarative HTTP tools. Provides the swappable `web.search` and `web.extract` layers, so selecting it in the layer picker re-points the stable `web.search` / `web.extract` tools at DeepSeek without changing what agents call. Billed per successful request; requires a BYOK DeepSeek API key.
tagline: DeepSeek's own search engine, built for models

config.description: Web search on DeepSeek's own engine. Returns reranked results with a title, URL, short snippet, a longer model-readable summary, a 0-3 rerank_score, a 0-4 authority tier, and the publication date. The query accepts site:, -site:, "phrase", -term, lang:, after: and before: operators. Billed per successful request. Requires RYU_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

query.description: The search query, 1-128 characters. Supports site:, -site:, "exact phrase", -term, lang:zh,en, after:YYYY-MM-DD and before:YYYY-MM-DD operators.

ori_question.description: The user's original question, 1-128 characters, used to improve ranking.

need_content.description: Also return each page's full content (default false, which leaves content empty).

config.description: Fetch one web page and return its title and content as markdown. Success depends on the target site's availability and access policy. Billed per successful request. Requires RYU_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

url.description: The http(s) URL of the page to fetch, without embedded credentials (up to 8192 characters).

fields.label: DeepSeek API key
fields.description: Create a key at https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys and paste it here. Search and fetch are billed per successful request against your DeepSeek balance. Stored encrypted on this node and never shown again — re-paste to change it. Without a key the DeepSeek tools stay installed but return nothing, so `web.search` / `web.extract` fall back to whichever other provider you select.
